content.description: Exploded view diagram showing air conditioning compressor assembly components including drive belt, idle pulley, compressor mount, and compressor unit

items: RUN ENGINE AT IDLE WITH AIR CONDITIONING ON FOR 10 MINUTES
DISCONNECT CLUTCH LEAD WIRE FROM WIRING HARNESS
DISCHARGE REFRIGERANT FROM REFRIGERATION SYSTEM (See page AC-12)

DISCONNECT TWO FLEXIBLE HOSES FROM COMPRESSOR SERVICE VALVES
Cap the open fitting immediately to keep moisture out of the system.

REMOVE COMPRESSOR
(a) Loosen the drive belt.
(b) Remove the compressor mounting bolts and the compressor.
